repos.description: Fennec, the native Rust engine: cargo build --release produces target/release/fennec(.exe), launched directly with the serve/run/info/plan/doctor verbs. Legacy fallback: an existing JustVugg/colibri checkout at any configured engine_root still works, because its c/coli launcher speaks the same CLI verbs and the same OpenAI-compatible HTTP contract; Fennec wins when both are present.
Shared agent runtime; pyproject supplies fastapi, uvicorn, psutil and fennec-agent.
The only pip-installed Fennec CLI; the engine itself is a native cargo-built binary, not a pip package.
Coding-agent web/PWA assets served by the shared core.
IDE integration; plugin packaging is a separate step.
Upstream Jev browser agent, cloned only. Fennec drives it through its own jev_ultrafast.Agent API and never edits, patches or vendors it. Its TypeSafe key stays inside this checkout.
Upstream OpenBot coworker workspace, cloned only. The user installs its dependencies and runs it; Fennec talks to its existing loopback AG-UI routes and never edits, patches or vendors it.

inference.description: Local Fennec engine (native Rust, cargo build --release) and command-line runtime; a legacy Colibri c/coli checkout is still launched when no Fennec binary is built.

desktop.description: Native Rust desktop on the shared agent server and engine; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

coding-agent.description: Local inference plus shared coding-agent server and web UI; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

jetbrains.description: Local engine and agent for the IDE plugin; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

speech.description: Local speech-to-text sidecar (faster-whisper CPU) for the core and PWA; av<18 because PyAV 18 removed metadata_errors.

npu.description: Accelerator sidecar packages (device probe + batched code index) for the interpreter the apps use; the embedding model is a prebuilt OpenVINO IR download, so optimum-intel and torch are never installed here. Never native token decoding.

fine-tune.description: Explicit opt-in to large training dependencies.

mobile.description: Shared core + PWA on the same device (Termux phone or desktop); the local engine starts on demand; pip deps are the local STT sidecar.

browser-outlets.description: Optional browser agents the shared core can delegate to: Jev (web_task) and OpenBot (coworker_task). Clone-only — upstream sources are never modified, their dependencies are never installed and neither is ever started by this hub.
